title: Deliverance
actors: Jon Voight, Burt Reynolds, Ned Beatty
plot: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's dammed and turned into a lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a canoeing trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.
awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 2 wins & 14 nominations total
